items.title: NavArgument builder rejects missing/null defaults and accepts mismatched typed defaults
required_tests: Typed Int without default builds and is required.
Nullable String with explicit null builds and retains defaultValuePresent=true.
Nonnullable Int with null or String default rejects at build, not later.
All built-in scalar and array defaults, missing-required predicate and verify behavior are covered on JVM/JS/Wasm/Native.

items.title: AdaptiveBundle violates documented runtime type and fallback contracts
required_tests: Wrong-type get<Int> from a String follows the chosen contract without an unexpected caller ClassCastException.
getString of Int42 returns the documented fallback/null rather than "42".
All explicitly supported scalar/array/list setters have consistent generic insertion and retrieval rules.
Explicit null versus absent key, aliasing and mutation behavior are documented/tested.

items.title: AdaptiveNavType inference and serialization are incomplete and not reliably round-trippable
required_tests: StringArray inference succeeds for empty and nonempty arrays and rejects mixed arrays.
Round-trip null, literal "null", Unicode, slash/query/hash/ampersand characters and every supported array type.
Unknown/custom fromArgType fails with a truthful supported-types error.
Benchmark/bound repeated-array parsing before adopting it for large external inputs.

items.title: AdaptiveNavHost retains stale graph closures and does not initialize a replacement controller
required_tests: Replace a controller at one composition site and verify initialization and callback routing.
Recompose after an outer callback/state changes and confirm graph content sees intended values.
Change startDestination with an empty and nonempty stack under an explicit policy.

items.title: Unknown routes and duplicate graph registrations silently render blank or select the first definition
required_tests: Duplicate route registration produces a deterministic diagnostic.
Navigate/start/restore with an unknown route has explicit behavior and no silent blank screen.
Restore a route removed by an app upgrade using the documented fallback.

items.title: Navigation exposes two incompatible controller abstractions and lacks a declared platform capability contract
required_tests: Compile a common consumer using the supported controller factory/host API on every target.
Android system/predictive back, iOS app-provided back/gesture behavior, desktop keyboard back and web history are tested according to the declared contract.
Per-entry lifecycle/viewmodel/restoration requirements are specified before release.

items.title: CupertinoIcon leaves the private-use glyph Text semantics exposed
required_tests: A null-description icon contributes no readable PUA text semantics.
A labeled icon contributes one image label and no additional glyph announcement.
Icons inside buttons preserve the button action/label in merged and unmerged trees.
Run TalkBack, VoiceOver and desktop/browser accessibility checks at different font scales.

items.title: Generated icon/symbol catalogues lack a reproducible generator and Apple availability metadata
required_tests: Regenerate all catalogues deterministically with zero unexplained diff.
Retain checks for unique identifiers, aliases, valid referenced names and cmap coverage.
Resolve representative/newest SF names on oldest/current supported iOS versions with a deliberate missing-symbol fallback.
Render glyph snapshots and check icon alignment, tint and accessibility.

items.title: Sample secure password text field logs every entered value
required_tests: Type a synthetic password and confirm its bytes never appear in captured test logs.
Source assertion prevents interpolation of secure-field content into logging calls.
Verify secure keyboard/display behavior separately on an iOS device.

items.title: Sample image export runs unbounded reads and image allocations without error or concurrency control
required_tests: Corrupt/empty/revoked/large-dimension images fail gracefully without crashing or leaking handles.
Rapid repeated export and navigation away cancel/serialize work correctly.
Measure peak memory and UI responsiveness on representative Android/iOS/JVM devices and browsers.
Encoder failure and multi-select hundreds-of-images paths have bounded work and lazy rendering.

items.title: Streaming sample cancellation does not interrupt its synchronous read loop
required_tests: Slow fake source counts reads after cancellation and proves prompt termination/close.
Reselect a file and leave the screen while counting; old work stops and does not overwrite new results.
Run large native/JVM input with a defined cancellation latency bound.
Correct sample memory claims for JS/Wasm buffering.

items.title: Android sample permission menu and manifest disagree and declare unrelated broad permissions
required_tests: Inspect the merged manifest and map every menu permission to its expected declaration/status for supported API levels.
Test Call on a fresh installation under an explicitly approved demo variant.
Verify file/image picker operation without MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and unrelated SMS permissions.
Run permission denial/permanent-denial and Android13/14 media-selection scenarios.

items.title: Derived Apache-2.0 source attribution needs reconstruction and artifact verification
required_tests: Compare distinctive source/docs against pinned AndroidX NavArgument/NavType and AOSP BaseBundle/Bundle headers.
Trace original Calf introduction commits and record whether the exact imported revision can be established.
Verify source and future binary distributions retain all established Apache notices.
Verify Compose Cupertino/Kyant source and notice correspondence, preserving copyright text and recording whether exact original copy revisions can be recovered.

items.title: Permission lifecycle refresh skips previously granted permissions, leaving revocations stale
required_tests: Granted notification/camera/location toggled off in Settings then resume without process death.
Denied-to-granted, one-time grant expiry, repeated resumes, batched permissions and lifecycle disposal.

items.title: iOS location delegates consume pending requests on nonterminal events and overwrite overlapping callbacks
required_tests: Initial NotDetermined followed by grant/deny produces one terminal result.
Double tap, reentrant launch in callback, status event after disposal, multiple helper instances.

items.title: iOS WriteCalendar requests full read/write access and rejects write-only authorization
required_tests: Fresh WriteCalendar requests only write access.
WriteOnly grants WriteCalendar but not ReadCalendar; full access grants both; restricted/denied remain denied.

items.title: iOS Bluetooth request lifetime and completion need device-backed hardening
required_tests: Force Kotlin/Native GC while permission dialog waits, consent after >2s, powered-off/resetting hardware, unsupported BT.
Repeated/reentrant requests, throwing callbacks, composition disposal; Instruments/leak and scan activity inspection.

items.title: iOS RemoteNotification skips APNs registration when notification authorization already exists
required_tests: Fresh permission, already authorized at launch, local then remote, provisional/ephemeral, denied; assert registration call count/main thread.
Valid/missing APNs entitlement and native registration success/failure callbacks on device.

items.title: PermissionStatus loses partial capability, precision and requestability distinctions
required_tests: iOS reduced/full accuracy and temporary full accuracy, limited/full contacts, selected/all photos, provisional/ephemeral notifications.
Android14 selected media, approximate location, first deny/second deny/never asked and unsupported targets.

items.title: Desktop, JS and Wasm permissions are nonfunctional stubs with silent callbacks
required_tests: Desktop/macOS sandbox behavior; browser camera/microphone/location/notifications with unavailable API, insecure context and denial.
Every stub path completes once with a documented unsupported result rather than silently doing nothing.

items.title: Non-Android geolocation trackers only print messages and report fabricated zero coordinates
required_tests: Compile a common-code usage sample; verify supported/unsupported outcome on every target.
iOS usage keys/denial/accuracy, browser secure contexts/watch cancellation, desktop provider absence.

items.title: Android geo data treats missing accuracy/speed/bearing/altitude as real zero measurements
required_tests: Construct Android Locations with each metadata flag independently absent/present on API23/26+.
True zero vs missing value, coarse/stale/mock fixes, negative altitude, unit and epoch checks.

items.title: Storage guidance asks for all-files access that WriteStorage never requests or verifies
required_tests: API28 legacy permission, API29 legacy/scoped target modes, API30+ app-scoped/SAF and all-files absent/present.
Verify docs examples request the least permissions needed and no Granted result is described as unrestricted disk access.

items.title: Replacing iOS date state can skip initialization effects for the new native picker
required_tests: Replace state A with state B that has equal selected date/rule/colors and inspect native min/max, tint, RTL and enabled state.
Repeat for compact disabled fields and range picker.
Recompose without identity changes and assert no redundant view recreation.

items.title: Empty or reversed date-bound intersections reach native interval APIs without a defined policy
required_tests: Direct reversed min/max; same UTC day with reversed intraday endpoints; disjoint and rules.
Native inline/compact/wheels/range application and subsequent nonempty recovery.
Extreme supported dates and null endpoints.

items.title: Compact Material date dialog can commit stale or newly forbidden scratch selections
required_tests: Open March15, choose March16, tighten maximum to March15, then confirm.
Replace state/rules/yearRange while dialog is open.
Rule rejects all days, null selection, cancel and reopening remain correct.

items.title: Native range highlighting eagerly allocates every day of a selected range on the UI path
required_tests: Instrument one-day, one-year and full default-range selection on old and current iPhones.
Benchmark allocation/time while changing range endpoints and rules.
Verify disabled gaps and displayed highlights after rule updates.

items.title: Time-state constructor checks the hour twice and never validates the minute on iOS
required_tests: Minute-1,0,59,60; hour-1,0,23,24 on both actuals.
Save/restore valid values and corrupted saved inputs.

items.title: Remembered native time picker keeps writing to the original state after replacement
required_tests: Replace stateA with different hour/minute stateB; native edits must only changeB.
Controller replacement, timezone/locale change, and recompose with identical state.

items.title: Changing the sheet confirmation callback recreates remembered sheet state
required_tests: Open a sheet, change a value captured by confirmValueChange, and assert identity/currentValue remain stable while new policy is used.
Restore state and change density; structural skip-flag changes follow documented policy.

items.title: Clearing native navigation-bar items leaves the previous tabs visible
required_tests: Populate two tabs, update to empty, then repopulate; assert native items and callbacks.
Selection index out of bounds and item reorder.

items.title: iOS toolbar does not implement its documented Material fallback
required_tests: Pre26/26+ with empty and populated iosItems, expanded changes and content counters.
Modifiers/insets, simultaneous bottom bar, keyboard and orientation.

items.title: Dropdown availability check rejects later iOS major versions and selects a private-gesture fallback
required_tests: Version cases17.3,17.4,17.10,18.0,26.0,26.4 and malformed components.
Programmatic open on supported OS and documented behavior on older OS.

items.title: Native dropdown reports dismissal immediately after opening and cannot follow expanded=false
required_tests: Open, dismiss by outside tap, select item, set expanded=false programmatically, reopen immediately.
Callback ordering/cardinality and trigger inside moved/nested controller.

items.title: Material dropdown silently drops most public popup and styling parameters
required_tests: Nondefault offset/scrollState, dismissOnBackPress/dismissOnClickOutside/focusability where supported.
Custom shape/colors/elevations/border and long scrollable contents.
Android/Desktop/browser regression matrix.

items.title: Liquid Glass slider arithmetic does not guard zero-length or invalid numeric ranges
required_tests: 0..0, negative range, reversed range, NaN/infinite value/endpoints and out-of-range initial values.
Zero-width, very narrow and unbounded horizontal constraints, RTL, range change mid-animation.
No NaN/Infinity reaches layout or velocity state.

items.title: AdaptiveSlider drops discrete steps on the iOS26 Liquid Glass branch
required_tests: steps0,1,3 and invalid negative; drag/tap/accessibility values on pre26 and26+.
Nonzero/negative ranges, RTL and endpoint rounding.

items.title: Cupertino slider accessibility snapping fails for negative target values
required_tests: Semantic setProgress on-1..1,steps3,target-0.7 expects-0.5.
All-negative range, zero/positive ranges, ties/endpoints and callback completion.

items.title: Cupertino slider gesture state has incomplete keys and uncancelled competing tap animations
required_tests: Change steps and range after initial composition and verify drag/tap/semantic parity.
Tap then immediately drag/opposite tap; cancel an active mutation and assert isDragging resets.
Interaction source replacement, RTL, disabled and completion callback counts.

items.title: Several iOS adaptive visual and interaction parameters are accepted but unused
required_tests: Distinctive custom colors/shape/padding/thumb content on both iOS branches.
Pressed/released/drag interactions observed through supplied MutableInteractionSource.
Disabled contrast, dark mode and large text snapshots.

items.title: ImageVector-to-UIImage conversion discards vector paints, transforms and clipping
required_tests: Nested translated/scaled/rotated groups, clips, even-odd fill, stroke-only paths, alpha and multiple colors.
RTL autoMirror, tint/template rendering,2x/3x density and non-square viewport.
Compare source ImageVector and resulting UIImage pixel snapshots on Apple.

items.title: Bitmap-to-UIImage bridge has unverified byte-order, premultiplication and buffer-lifetime assumptions
required_tests: Known1x1 red/blue/green/transparent/half-alpha pixels roundtrip to UIImage and composite over black/white.
Stress GC while converting, larger buffers, allocation failures and color-space assumptions.
Apple Address Sanitizer/native diagnostics where supported.

items.title: Native image conversion leaks CoreGraphics resources on the image-creation failure path
required_tests: Inject color-space/context/image creation failure and assert all owned resources release.
Zero/negative/truncated/huge vector dimensions and normal repeated conversions.
Instruments allocation/leak profile and GC stress.

items.title: Damped drag animation launches overlapping jobs per update and tracks velocity with wall-clock time
required_tests: Rapid press-release-press, high-frequency value updates, tap animation interrupted by drag.
Coroutine/job counts and frame-time/allocation trace under sustained interaction.
Clock changes, cancellation/disposal and range changes without pending release waits.

items.title: Applying a native view theme also mutates its parent view style
required_tests: Two native controls with opposite themes in one parent; update/remove each independently.
Mixed Compose/native sheets/popovers and transparent day-content colors.
System theme change and explicit caller overrides remain isolated.

items.title: MIME lookup is locale-sensitive, parses only comma-space lists, and allocates per entry
required_tests: tr-TR uppercase TIFF and IMAGE/PNG
Comma lists with zero/multiple spaces
Known scalar/wildcard equivalence
Adversarial bounded wildcard performance
Concurrent registration only if that API is retained

items.title: Native cache fallback can lose user isolation and loader trusts external search paths
required_tests: Missing user.home with shared temp directory
Precreated symlink/foreign-owned cache directory
Concurrent extraction and failed move
Mismatched native ABI from system path
Windows loaded-DLL reuse
Read-only home/noexec mount errors

items.title: Share subject is not delivered consistently and iOS assigns controller title instead of item subject
required_tests: iOS Mail subject for text, URL, single and multiple files.
Web payload inspection verifies title/file fields; unsupported metadata is documented.
Desktop native/fallback subject behavior is explicit and tested where implementable.

items.title: Maps, media and notification scaffolds must not be represented as implemented features
required_tests: Source/module inventory verifies empty/excluded status and published artifacts exclude incomplete APIs.
Future enabling requires fresh supported Gradle configuration, actual API contract, platform privacy/provider setup and device tests.
Roadmap links maps27 and media245 without claiming they are fixed.

items.title: Desktop customUserAgent cannot be reset to its documented default using null
required_tests: Set custom A, change to B, reset null and inspect actual request User-Agent/default engine value.
Multiple WebView instances preserve their individual defaults.

items.title: WebView settings changes and error accumulation perform avoidable full updates
required_tests: Assign identical settings repeatedly and apply a multi-setting batch; assert bounded native/FX calls.
Thousands of resource failures: benchmark allocation/time and preserve required error metadata.
Concurrent/UI-thread application still sees a coherent settings snapshot.

items.title: Sample includes an unused second navigation library with an unnecessary compatibility burden
required_tests: Search/import audit and dependency graph prove the library is unused.
Build Android/JVM/JS/Wasm/iOS sample targets after removal.
Only lower minSdk after merged-manifest/dependency and device verification.

items.title: Showcase reports a successful clipboard action that it never performs
required_tests: Assert the dialog text is truthful for the chosen demonstration behavior.
If copy is implemented, verify clipboard content from one explicit user tap on each supported platform.

items.title: Specify and test the numerical domain and undefined-bearing policy of LatLng
required_tests: Identical/cardinal/dateline/poles/antipodes, very close points, nonfinite/out-of-range data.
Properties symmetry/distance bounds, rounded0..350 vs unrounded[0,360), precision across JVM/JS/Wasm/Native.

items.title: Single-date state loses displayed-month intent on iOS and save/restore
required_tests: Selected month differs from displayed month, with/without a selection.
Save/restore after month navigation; legacy five-element input.
Native compact/wheels/inline appropriate behavior.

items.title: No-selectable-day fallback is intentional but requires an explicit caller-visible validation policy
required_tests: NoDates, valid day367+ days away, tie between previous/next, changing effective bounds.
Tests for chosen explicit validity/empty-selection policy and its accessibility announcement.

items.title: Native time picker ignores the public is24Hour preference
required_tests: 12-hour and24-hour system settings with is24Hour true/false and multiple locales.
Accessibility time readout and SavedState restoration.

items.title: rememberAlertDialogIosProperties does not remember changes to textFields
required_tests: Recompose with stable actions/title/etc and a different textFields list; assert returned properties follow it.
Same-value stable inputs retain normal behavior.

items.title: Internal expandable FAB loses expanded items on model updates and is not ready for public exposure
required_tests: Update items/main item while expanded and collapsed, including empty lists.
Touches through collapsed empty area, RTL, rotation, tab bar presence and varying safe areas.
Accessible labels/actions and no item titles in production logs.

items.title: Liquid button eagerly builds an unused highlight shader and lacks a measured effects budget
required_tests: Trace construction/allocation with100 buttons and no highlight drawing modifier.
Frame time/GPU overdraw on supported older and current Apple hardware.
Reduced motion/transparency, dark mode, scrolling backgrounds and fallback backdrop behavior.

items.title: A delayed Cupertino button release animation can clear the next press highlight
required_tests: Press/release at20ms, re-press before100ms, hold; alpha stays pressed until final release.
Cancel, multiple pointers and node detach with pending jobs.

items.title: Cupertino activity indicator ignores input alpha and draws the first spoke twice
required_tests: Transparent and half-alpha colors; pixel snapshots of the eight unique spoke positions.
One animation cycle at fixed times and semantics retained.
